create.title: Terminal-height completion of every fixed nonlower M1 radial sector
create.statement_tex: Let R=X^(1/4), Y=sqrt X, D_j=2^(-j)floor(Y), H_j=floor(D_j/R), fix 0<s_0<8, kappa=sqrt(s_0)/4, and insert a fixed smooth vartheta(h/H_j), zero for h/H_j<=kappa/2 and one for h/H_j>=kappa, into every nonempty literal (j,h)-atom of C_X^*(n), defining C_(T,X)^*(n). Then sum_(n<=N_X)^* C_(T,X)^*(n)n^(-3/4)e(sqrt(Xn))<<_(epsilon,s_0)X^epsilon. The certified profile support 1/2<=t<=3/2 and exact floors imply C_(T,X)^*(n)=C_X^*(n) for n/Y>=s_0 and C_(T,X)^*(n)=0 for n/Y<s_0/144. For every fixed lower cutoff V_low=1 on s<=s_0 and 0 on s>=2s_0, an antecedent-level auxiliary compact multiplier proves the V_low-weighted terminal sum is O_epsilon(X^epsilon). Hence sum_(n<=N_X)^*(1-V_low(n/Y))C_X^*(n)n^(-3/4)e(sqrt(Xn))<<_epsilon X^epsilon. The proof uses the terminal frequency BV bound, the coefficientwise positive smooth and one-sided hard transforms, absolute polylogarithmic errors, exact floors, stars, hard sample, and conjugate negative sign. Endpoint-prefix and R1 modules are alternative-route owners and are not inserted.
create.next_action: Use this theorem only for the whole fixed nonlower radial complement. The exact lower-radial signed aggregate remains independent; do not infer blockwise M9-M1 from this global owner.

update.statement_tex: Fix a Round-98 one-count radial partition 1=V_low+sum_a V_a+U, where V_low is one near zero, each V_a is fixed and compact inside (0,16), and U is the sharp upper/interface remainder through N_X=floor(16sqrt X) with its outer star. The terminal-height whole-nonlower theorem gives G_X[1-V_low]<<_epsilon X^epsilon, and the proved compact critical transfer gives every G_X[V_a]<<_epsilon X^epsilon. Therefore G_X[U]=G_X[1-V_low]-sum_a G_X[V_a]<<_epsilon X^epsilon, with the exact C_X^* coefficient, floors, profile stars, hard sample, signs, and outer product tie. No endpoint-prefix identification, C approaching 16, moving seminorm, arbitrary finite Mellin height, alpha connector, endpoint/R1 duplication, or extra flat owner is used.
update.reason_for_promotion: The terminal-height theorem proves the stronger whole nonlower complement at normalized X^epsilon scale. Exact subtraction of the already proved compact critical cells then proves the old sharp radial/interface owner with all physical one-count seams audited.

Its fixed-ratio terminal strength now closes every fixed nonlower radial sector through a height cutoff. It still gives a growing D/L loss when h/H_j tends to zero, exactly the remaining lower-radial problem.
Use the exact coefficient either in the proved nonlower theorem or the open lower-radial aggregate. Do not localize this global result back to an individual physical block.

reject.reason: The certified smooth profile has closed support through t=3/2. The lawful constant is C_W=3/2, giving the terminal lower radial threshold c_T=s_0/144.

V_low equals one at zero and is not compactly supported in the positive half-line. The proof requires an auxiliary fixed compact multiplier inserted at the reciprocal antecedent, where terminal-height geometry makes it exactly one on every surviving summand.

The whole nonlower complement also contains the already proved compact critical cells. The old interface follows only after their exact coefficientwise subtraction, or under a new exact two-piece lower/complement partition.

The collar retains U(n/Y)e(sqrt(Xn)), whereas the physical integration-by-parts prefix has constant phase e(sqrt(XN_X)). The terminal-height proof bounds the collar directly and never identifies the two.

The physical endpoint boundary and R1 modules belong to a different transformed routing. They are inserted zero times in the terminal-height radial proof and are not relabelled as Poisson transform errors.

The transform is coefficientwise in h. The new sampled height cutoff has BV O(1/H_j); accepted per-frequency remainders are summed absolutely on h asymp H_j, and the hard cotangent boundary has O(1) terminal h^(-1) mass.

The proof uses only the physical finite reciprocal sums and an ordinary Mellin inversion of one fixed compact radial multiplier. It supplies no uniform finite Perron- or Mellin-height theorem for the endpoint modules.
GAR still needs the exact lower-radial signed aggregate. Even full GAR controls only the total active M1 sum and has no inverse implication to either direct blockwise M1 parent.

no_change.reason: Both direct blockwise physical parents remain open; the proved interface is part of an alternative total-active-M1 route.
Its hard TOP, balanced, and unbalanced parents are independent of this M1 radial result.
No endpoint-uniformity theorem is proved or required inside the scoped radial interface lemma.
Neither blockwise M9-M1 nor M9-M2 is proved.
The lower-radial GAR parent, M9-M2, and the remaining bridge requirements stay open; no discrepancy exponent changes.
